WITH calendar AS (SELECT ? AS "bucket", ? AS "stop" UNION ALL SELECT ? AS "bucket", ? AS "stop" UNION ALL SELECT ? AS "bucket", ? AS "stop" UNION ALL SELECT ? AS "bucket", ? AS "stop")
SELECT "time_bucket", "revenue"
FROM (
SELECT calendar."bucket" AS "time_bucket", SUM(t."net_amount") AS "revenue"
FROM "sale_lines" AS t
INNER JOIN calendar ON t."sold_on" >= calendar."bucket" AND t."sold_on" < calendar."stop"
WHERE t."store_code" = ? AND t."voided" = ? AND t."sold_on" >= ? AND t."sold_on" < ?
GROUP BY calendar."bucket"
) AS report
ORDER BY "time_bucket" ASC
LIMIT ?

SELECT TOP (?) [time_bucket], [revenue]
FROM (
SELECT calendar.[bucket] AS [time_bucket], SUM(t.[net_amount]) AS [revenue]
FROM [dbo].[sale_lines] AS t
INNER JOIN calendar ON t.[sold_on] >= calendar.[bucket] AND t.[sold_on] < calendar.[stop]
WHERE t.[store_code] = ? AND t.[voided] = ? AND t.[sold_on] >= ? AND t.[sold_on] < ?
GROUP BY calendar.[bucket]
) AS report

queries.sqlite:
WITH r0 AS (SELECT s."store_code" AS "k0", s."sku" AS "k1", MIN(s."department") AS "v0", COUNT(*) AS "__count" FROM "products" AS s WHERE s."store_code" IS NOT NULL AND s."sku" IS NOT NULL AND s."store_code" = ? AND s."listed" = ? GROUP BY s."store_code", s."sku")
SELECT "revenue", CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r0 WHERE "__count" > 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "__sageql_relation_guard"
FROM (
SELECT SUM(t."net_amount") AS "revenue"
FROM "sale_lines" AS t
LEFT JOIN r0 ON t."store_code" = r0."k0" AND t."sku" = r0."k1"
WHERE t."store_code" = ? AND t."voided" = ? AND r0."v0" = ? AND t."sold_on" >= ? AND t."sold_on" < ?
) AS report
LIMIT ?
